turns.teacher: Good morning children, chalo sit down properly. Today we do subtraction. Fifty two minus twenty seven, ka answer batao?
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: Rabi, thirty five? No no, galat hai. Wrong. Arjoon, you tell.
turns.label: move_on_or_scold

turns.teacher: Arjun, the answer is twenty five. Fifty two minus twenty seven is twenty five. Sab log bolo, twenty five.
turns.label: tell_answer

turns.teacher: Listen again. Two minus seven nahi hota, so take one ten. Twelve minus seven five. Four minus two two. Twenty five. Take one ten, twelve minus seven, five! Samjhe ki nahi?
turns.label: repeat_same_way

turns.teacher: Who understood? Thumbs up karo. Haan, everybody thumbs up.
turns.label: check_whole_class

turns.teacher: Now do this one in copy. Sixty three minus twenty eight. Jaldi jaldi.
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: Mina, you are counting on fingers again? Fingers se nahi hoga. Stop it. Answer is thirty five, write it and keep copy on my table.
turns.label: tell_answer
